newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi American Bank 1996 net profit drops to $245 million.
- Saudi plans to build three colleges at a cost of $40 million.
- Yemen allocates $13 million to develop Aden airport.
- Around 40 plants closed in Amman industrial area, investments moved to Egypt.
